messages:
Maria: Quick sync: were seeing flaky links between logs and traces for frontend -> api -> runtime. Some logs don't have a stable top-level trace id so consoles "Jump to trace" often fails. Can we agree a field contract and a rollout path?
AJ: Proposal — canonical top-level keys: `trace_id` (32-char lowercase hex), `span_id` (8-16 hex chars), and `parent_id` optional. Keep them strings.
Leo: Agreed on top-level fields. Also suggest accepting legacy keys like `otel.trace_id` during transition. Our ingestion should detect either and normalize.
Samir: Language variance: browsers and some JS libs produce 16-char ids, Go sometimes 32 but no padding. Ingest should normalize to 32-char hex (left-pad with zeros). Also strip any `0x` prefixes and lowercase.
infra-bot: collector v2 rolled out to nodes; includes remap transforms for field renaming/normalization.
Elaine: Example we want in logs (single-line JSON):

```
{"ts":"2025-11-02T15:12:03Z","level":"info","service":"api","msg":"handled","trace_id":"a3f0b1c2d3e4f56789abcdef01234567","span_id":"4d2e6f00","path":"/v1/generate"}
```

This lets the console find traces by `trace_id` reliably.
Maria: Two questions: 1) enforce 32 chars or accept both until rollout? 2) indexing cost — we cant index trace_id across all logs by default.
AJ: Plan: normalize to 32-char at ingestion immediately (pad short ids). Start with storing `trace_id` as a non-indexed field. Add an opt-in tokenized index behind a feature flag for orgs that need fast log->trace lookups.
Leo: Roadmap suggestion:
- libs: emit `trace_id` & `span_id` top-level (docs + lint) — 3w
- ingestion: vector remap to lowercase & pad — immediate
- search: feature-flag tokenized index for trace_id, opt-in per-org — 2w
- console: implement log->trace jump that hits traces API (non-index fallback uses a backend scan with rate-limits) — 1w
Start with feature-flag off for everyone.
Samir: For browser OTEL (16-char): padding is OK but document in SDKs. Add unit tests in SDKs to validate emitted trace_id format.
Elaine: Add guardrails on the console: debounce hot queries, cap qps for trace lookups, and show a warning when the jump might be slow. Also surface if a logs trace_id was normalized so debugging knows padding happened.
Maria: Rollout: two-week canary on staging + beta orgs, then enable opt-in index for a small set of enterprise customers. Also add a CI lint rule to SDKs that fails if trace fields are nested (e.g., `metadata.trace` instead of top-level).
AJ: I'll open PRs: vector remap, ingestion normalization tests, and feature-flag for indexing. Will add an integration test that emits an OTLP trace and a log with the same trace_id and asserts the console jump resolves.
Leo: One more exporter note: ensure OTLP pipeline preserves the canonical 32-char hex. If a backend expects 128-bit, our collector should pass through.
infra-bot: created INF-849: "log<->trace field normalization + opt-in trace_id index" assigned to @AJ, milestone sprint-48.
Elaine: Quick Node middleware snippet to include in SDK README:

```js
// express middleware: attach otel trace to pino logs
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const traceId = getOtelTraceId() || generateFallback();
  // ensure we attach as top-level string `trace_id`
  req.log = req.log.child({ trace_id: traceId });
  next();
});
```

Note: prefer SDK hook rather than manual wiring.
Maria: Thanks. AJ — post the PR links and a rollout checklist in #eng-platform tomorrow. Keep the feature flag default off until we verify costs.
AJ: Will do. Starting work tonight.
Leo: :thumbsup:
